title: Remove CLEAN27 from Warehouse
summary: Removes code guarded by CLEAN27 from warehouse codeunits, tables and a report in the Base Application. Elements obsoleted earlier are now deleted, so extensions still using them must be updated.
key_points: Deletes 711 lines of CLEAN27 code across 11 warehouse objects
Touches the inventory pick, movement and put-away creation codeunits, plus Create Pick and Create Put-away
Touches the Whse.-Activity-Post, Whse.-Activity-Register and Whse. Jnl.-Register Line codeunits
Also cleans up the Warehouse Entry, Warehouse Register and Warehouse Setup tables and the Whse. Get Bin Content report
Extensions that still reference the removed obsolete elements will no longer compile
